recordedProductIssues: Highlight ring and badge on the small Cancel button are tiny at feed size; dim scrim hides the page.

defects.problem: Same still held with large 'Goal' column; screenshot small and masked, so feed-size shows only black bars.
defects.fix: Enlarge screen; drop the Goal column to a caption.

defects.problem: Highlighted Cancel button is about 50 px wide at feed size; the SAM outline versus Spark box difference is not discernible, so the claim is carried by caption only.

defects.problem: Caption 'Box overlap 0.89, needs 0.5' lingers many frames while the picture is unchanged; yellow title highlight is reused every slide (templated).
